title: Reverse with a stack
description:
A stack gives things back in the opposite order to the order they went in. Use that to write `std::string reversed(std::string_view text)`.

Push every character onto a `std::vector<char>` with `push_back`, then repeatedly read the top with `back()` and remove it with `pop_back()` until the stack is empty.
hints: Two loops: the first pushes every character with `push_back`; the second, `while (!stack.empty())`, appends `stack.back()` to the result and then calls `pop_back()`.
lessonTitle: Vector as a Stack, and Capacity
